svg.text: 🏆 ROUND 208 · 430-PLAYGROUND-VECTOR FLAGSHIP MILESTONE (208 FAQs / 444 Scenarios / 954 Assertions)
SEMI C3.73 / GB/T 34972 · 10,000-TPA 6N5 Iodine Pentafluoride (IF₅) & Heptafluoride (IF₇) Thermal ALE Gas
Semiconductor 1nm Thermal ALE & 3D DRAM Clean IF₅ / IF₇ Complex: Hydrolysis Blast & HIO₃ Plug vs. Broker
Cuts Synthetic Fixture ASR from 75.0% to 0.0% · In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248ms · Hardwired IF₅ 15–45°C Anti-Freeze-Thaw Lock + <=1.85 kg/L Fill Cutoff + Dry-N₂ Reductive Venturi
🔴 Unbrokered Baseline: Poisoned SEMI C3.73 Assay Quadruple Breach (ASR = 75.0%)
1. Interhalogen Hypergolic Oxidizer: IF₅/IF₇ + Water/IPA Explosion + HIO₃↓ Valve Plug
• IF₅/IF₇ contact w/ water or organics triggers IF₅ + 3 H₂O → HIO₃↓ + 5 HF↑ (-2,185 kJ/kg),
releasing 505 L/kg anhydrous HF while crystalline HIO₃/I₂O₅ & I₂ needles cement relief valves!
2. 3.19 g/cm³ Ultra-Dense Liquid Overfill (>1.85 kg/L) + +9.4°C Freeze-Thaw Rupture
• Liquid IF₅ (3.19 g/cm³) freezes at +9.4°C; overfilling to 2.95 kg/L & bottom-heating frozen
cylinders to 135°C under a solid ice plug generates >32 MPa hydraulic rupture (-2,840 kJ/kg)!
3. 6N5 1nm GAA Nanosheet Thermal ALE Recipe Exfil + $4,990 Titanium-Valve Fraud
• Scheduling agent reads restricted-budget & leaks 6N5 IF₅/IF₇ thermal ALE & 3D DRAM recipes

🟢 Zero-Trust Capability Broker + SIL3 Anti-Freeze/Monel-400 Interlocks (Hardened ASR = 0.0%)
1. Hardwired SIL3 Lock 1: IF₅ 15–45°C Thermal Window + Dual-Scale <=1.85 kg/L Cutoff
• Warm-air jacket locked to 15–45°C (preventing <9.4°C ice-plug freeze-thaw & >50°C overpressure)
• Dual load-cells hard-trip filling at <=1.85 kg/L within <15 ms, preserving >15% ullage
2. Hardwired SIL3 Lock 2: NiF₂-Passivated Monel 400 + Dry-N₂ KOH/Na₂SO₃ Venturi
• 100% NiF₂-passivated Monel 400 / Nickel-200 valves w/ PFPE (zero Ti, Al, glass, or hydrocarbon)
• Dry-N₂ concentric Venturi w/ KOH + Na₂SO₃ reduces HIO₃/I₂ into soluble I⁻/F⁻ without plugging
3. Deterministic Capability Broker (Broker.evaluate 0.0248ms): 5 Invariant Rules
• record-owner isolates 6N5 IF₅/IF₇ Vault; untrusted-write blocks tainted overfill/water writes
• restricted-data-boundary halts IP exfil; fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment
